user.title: Connect Tuliprox
user.description: Enter the server base URL and login. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks. Xtream credentials are optional and enable account/content sensors.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tuliprox
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or login. Enter the password again. The connection is validated before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate Tuliprox again
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication was rejected. Enter valid connection details and the password again.

error.invalid_input: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials, query parameters or fragments, and a nonempty username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve valid status and stream responses from the server.
error.invalid_xtream_auth: Xtream authentication was rejected. Xtream credentials have been removed.

abort.already_configured: This server URL is already configured.

init.title: Tuliprox options
init.description: Poll every 10-3600 seconds. Enter up to 20 exact, case-sensitive usernames separated by commas. Leave empty to disable user tracking.

error.invalid_users: Enter up to 20 plain usernames, each at most 64 characters, without URLs or credential-like values.
